stem: 哪种涉及供应商的情况会给组织带来更高的反洗钱和/或制裁风险？

options.A: 供应商向位于受经济制裁地区的终端用户提供服务
options.B: 该供应商的销售代表小时候曾是来自一个受制裁司法管辖区的难民
options.C: 该供应商是以私营公司形式组织的
options.D: 该供应商不存在拥有或控制公司10%以上权益的个人

stem_en: Which situation involving a vendor presents increased AML and/or sanctions risk to an organization?

options_en.A: The vendor provides services to end users located in an area subject to economic sanctions
options_en.B: The vendor's sales representative was a refugee from a sanctioned jurisdiction as a child
options_en.C: The vendor is organized as a privately held company
options_en.D: The vendor has no individuals that own or control more than 10% of the company
